description: Machine registry of the 24 stable normative requirement IDs of docs/FACTORY-LOOP-SPEC.md section 24. The deterministic parser (.factory/loop/plan_parser.py) loads this file as part of the acceptance boundary and rejects any conformance matrix that misses, duplicates, or exceeds these IDs (PLAN-01, Task 18 item 3). An adopting product must not edit this registry: the requirement policy map (.factory/requirement-policy.json) is the separate authority for required evidence tiers.
